idea-plugin.name: Agents Usage
idea-plugin.description:
Agents Usage

Monitor Codex, JetBrains AI, and GitHub Copilot usage directly in IntelliJ Platform IDEs, including IntelliJ IDEA and Rider. Maintained by Lars Nörber.

  • Displays remaining 5-hour and weekly quotas in the status bar.
  • Displays remaining JetBrains AI subscription and top-up credits when AI Assistant is installed.
  • Displays consumed GitHub Copilot quota from 0% unused to 100% exhausted when the Copilot plugin is installed.
  • Groups agents into compact accented cards with subscription badges, colored bars, and credit/reset details.
  • Colors status percentages directly and lets you choose visible agents with checkboxes.
  • Shows four compact facts per agent, with further quota, reset, subscription, and status details on demand.
  • Supports manual refresh and configurable automatic refresh intervals.
  • Automatically discovers the local Codex CLI from the system PATH.

Usage preview

Illustrated preview with example balances. Available quotas and subscription details depend on your plan and installed provider plugins.

OpenAI requirement: Codex CLI must be installed and signed in on the local machine. You can deselect OpenAI when monitoring only other agents.

This plugin reads usage locally through Codex CLI. It does not upload usage data. Codex is a trademark of OpenAI; this independent plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
